register.reg_condition: when FEAT_TPSP is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

text_before_fields.para: The values in this register are not permitted to be cached in a TLB.

field_description.para: The number of least-significant bits of address to ignore for the purpose of matching.
This field configures the base address of the thread-private region.
VA bits [63:56] are sign-extended from bit [55].
The most-significant bits of this field are RESS, according to the relevant TCR_EL2.TnSZ configuration, in the same manner as the most-significant bits in the existing VNCR_EL2 register.

The effects of TCR_EL2.TBI, and any other bit that affects the interpretation of the most-significant bits of a VA is IGNORED and this field should be programmed to a sign-extended VA according to the value of TCR_EL2.TnSZ.
Enable checking of accesses to thread-private memory.
This control applies to data accesses, other than unprivileged accesses, and cache maintenance operations, of the type configured in TPCR0_EL2.TPRW, made to thread-private pages.

field_value_description.para: No accesses of the specified type are permitted by TPCR1_EL2.
An access of the specified type does not generate a TPLIM Permission fault if the VA is in the range programmed in TPCR1_EL2.
